key_insight: Aeneas and Lean let the authors verify production Rust cryptographic code by extracting a pure model from ownership-checked Rust and proving correctness with kernel-checked proofs, including AI-assisted formalization.
engineering_relevance: This shows that verified cryptographic software can remain performant and deployable across x86-64 and ARM while supporting real-world post-quantum libraries and platform intrinsics.
method: Use Aeneas to translate Rust into a Lean-friendly pure model
Develop Lean tactics and libraries to simplify proofs over extracted code
Let AI agents draft proofs while Lean kernel independently checks them
evidence_signal: The team reports a 237KLOC Lean development proving safety, panic-freedom, and functional correctness for 16.7KLOC of Rust code across post-quantum cipher suites on x86-64 and ARM.
watch_item: Formalizing cryptographic standards and platform-specific intrinsics still needs expert design and careful review, so AI assistance does not remove all verification burden.
paper_title: Scaling Verification of Cryptographic Software with Aeneas, Rust, and Lean
